step.goal: Run phase-specific quality checks and collect issues with severity

check.action:
Run these checks — record each failure as { id, severity, description, detail }:
CRITICAL: SA-1 Verify AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json exists and is valid parseable JSON SA-2 acceptance_criteria array contains exactly {expected_ac_count} items — one per unique AC across ALL story files; list any missing ACs
HIGH: SA-3 Each AC text matches the original verbatim text from its source story file — no paraphrasing SA-4 At least 2 positive test scenarios are defined SA-5 At least 1 negative test scenario defined per AC (minimum count: {expected_ac_count})
MEDIUM: SA-6 Edge cases section is not empty — must include boundary values, empty input, max-length, special characters SA-7 Security scenarios section covers at minimum: unauthorised access attempt AND input injection
LOW: SA-8 Risks and Dependencies section is populated SA-9 Data Needed section lists concrete values, not vague placeholders

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: TC-1 Both XLSX and MD files exist at {output_folder}/{story_id}/test-cases/ TC-2 Every AC has at least one positive test case — total positives ≥ {expected_ac_count}; list uncovered ACs
HIGH: TC-3 Every AC has at least one negative test case covering invalid or rejected input TC-6 Every test case has all required fields populated — ID, title, description, preconditions, numbered steps, test data, expected result TC-9 No duplicate test case IDs
MEDIUM: TC-4 Edge case tests present: boundary values, empty inputs, max-length, special characters TC-5 Security and permission tests present if story involves auth or roles TC-7 No placeholder text ("[field]", "[value]", "TBD") in any step or data field TC-8 Expected results are specific and measurable — not vague phrases like "يعمل بشكل صحيح"
LOW: TC-10 All content is in {reporting_language} TC-11 Test types cover applicable categories: وظيفي، تحقق، حد، أمان، صلاحيات

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: E2E-1 Both .page.js and .spec.js exist inside {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — fail if in any host project folder E2E-12 Every page.goto() URL path is a valid reachable route: extract all paths, cross-reference against project.config.json routes.pages and host project router files; flag any unverifiable path
HIGH: E2E-7 Spec covers all {expected_ac_count} ACs — at least one positive test() per AC E2E-8 Each AC has at least one negative test case E2E-9 No hardcoded base URLs in page.goto() — must use baseURL from Playwright config E2E-11 Each test() block contains at least one meaningful expect() assertion
MEDIUM: E2E-2 Page Object uses JavaScript — no TypeScript syntax, no interface/type keywords E2E-3 POM constructor accepts page and assigns this.page = page E2E-4 All locators use this.page.locator() or Playwright locator methods E2E-5 Spec imports Page Object via relative path to pages/ folder E2E-6 Spec uses test.describe and individual test() blocks E2E-10 No page.waitForTimeout() — use waitForSelector() or expect().toBeVisible()

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: TD-1 All 3 JSON files exist: {suite_name}-valid.json, {suite_name}-edge.json, {suite_name}-security.json TD-6 All 3 files are valid parseable JSON — no trailing commas, unquoted keys, or syntax errors
HIGH: TD-3 valid.json credentials sourced from config.yaml test_users — NOT invented or hardcoded TD-7 Field names in JSON match form fields / API keys used in the spec file — no mismatches
MEDIUM: TD-2 valid.json has realistic domain-specific values — no generic "test123", "foo", "test@test.com" TD-4 edge.json covers: empty strings, null, max-length, special characters, zero, negative numbers TD-5 security.json contains: SQL injection (' OR '1'='1), XSS (<script>alert(1)</script>), oversized inputs
LOW: TD-8 Expected success/error messages match what the application actually returns

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: P5-1 junit.xml exists at {output_folder}/{story_id}/reports/junit.xml and is non-empty P5-2 Every failed test in junit.xml has a corresponding BUG-XXXX.md — {bug_report_count} must equal {failed_test_count}
HIGH: P5-3 Every bug report has a specific root cause — NOT "unknown error" or "test failed" P5-4 Every bug report contains the fix applied (before/after code snippet) P5-5 Every bug report has a retest outcome section (✅ Fixed or ❌ Still Open)
MEDIUM: P5-6 test-checklist.md reflects final state — no test still shows ⏳ Pending P5-8 Bug report count matches failed test count exactly
LOW: (none specific at this phase)

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: BG-1 One bug report per failed test in junit.xml — {bug_report_count} must equal {failed_test_count} BG-2 Each report has all required fields: Bug ID, عنوان المشكلة, وصف المشكلة, خطوات إعادة المشكلة, النتيجة الحالية, النتيجة المتوقعة, مستوى الخطورة, الأولوية
HIGH: BG-5 Root cause is SPECIFIC in every report — includes file path, line number, what went wrong; NOT generic text BG-8 Bug IDs are unique and sequential (BUG-0001, BUG-0002, …) — no duplicates or gaps
MEDIUM: BG-3 Each report includes evidence: screenshot/video/trace paths and console errors from junit.xml BG-4 Severity correctly classified: حرجة / عالية / متوسطة / منخفضة — not everything rated حرجة BG-6 Each report includes a concrete suggested fix based on the root cause
LOW: BG-7 All bug report content is in {reporting_language}

Run these checks:
CRITICAL: QR-1 All 3 report files exist: qa-report.html, qa-report.xlsx, qa-report.md QR-2 Pass rate in report matches {actual_pass_rate}% from junit.xml — not a placeholder QR-3 Bug count in report matches {actual_bug_count} files in bug-reports/
HIGH: QR-4 All {total_tests} test results are listed in the report — no tests omitted QR-8 Quality gate result (PASSED / FAILED vs {min_pass_rate}% threshold) is clearly stated in all 3 formats
MEDIUM: QR-6 HTML report is valid HTML — balanced tags, no broken structure QR-7 MD report contains all required sections: executive summary, pass rate, failed tests, bug severity breakdown, next actions
LOW: QR-5 All report content is in {reporting_language}

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.action: STOP

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report ║ ║ Suite : {suite_name} ║ ║ Phase : {current_status} ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" + what was found / what is expected) (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" + detail) (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

step.goal: Apply fixes based on user choice and active phase

check.output: ⏭️ No fixes applied. Issues remain for suite "{suite_name}" at phase "{current_status}".
check.action: STOP

For each selected issue: SA-1 → re-run /aiqa-analyzestory --suite {suite_name} to regenerate the AST SA-2 → re-read ALL {story_files}; extract every AC precisely; add missing items to acceptance_criteria array SA-3 → look up exact original text for each paraphrased AC in the story files; replace with verbatim text SA-4 → add positive scenarios covering the happy-path and an alternate success flow SA-5 → for each AC missing a negative scenario: add one covering invalid input, missing field, or auth failure SA-6 → add edge cases: empty input, max-length string, special chars (؟!@#), numeric boundaries SA-7 → add security scenarios: SQL injection attempt, XSS payload (<script>alert(1)</script>), auth bypass SA-8 → populate risks/dependencies based on story context (third-party services, migration, RBAC) SA-9 → replace vague placeholders with concrete values (e.g. "valid email" → "test@example.com") Save corrected AST to AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/reports/story-asts/{suite_name}.json

For each selected issue: TC-1 → re-run /aiqa-generatetestcases {suite_name} to regenerate missing files TC-2 → generate at least one positive test case for each AC with zero coverage TC-3 → add a negative test case for each AC missing one (invalid input + expected error) TC-4 → add edge case tests: empty input, max-length, special chars (؟!@#) TC-5 → add SQL injection, XSS, unauthenticated access, and RBAC denial test cases where story involves auth/roles TC-6 → fill every blank field in every test case with accurate, story-specific content TC-7 → replace all "[field]", "[value]", "TBD" with exact values from the story TC-8 → rewrite vague expected results to state specific outcomes, UI changes, or API responses TC-9 → renumber duplicate IDs sequentially (TC-0001, TC-0002, …) TC-10 → translate non-{reporting_language} content to {reporting_language} TC-11 → add test cases for missing applicable categories Save corrected files.

For each selected issue: E2E-1 → if files missing: re-run /aiqa-generatee2e {suite_name}; if in wrong location: move to correct path inside TestResult/ E2E-2 → convert TypeScript syntax to plain JavaScript E2E-3 → fix POM constructor to accept page and assign this.page = page E2E-4 → replace raw CSS selector strings with proper this.page.locator() calls E2E-5 → fix import path to use relative ../pages/{suite_name}.page.js E2E-6 → wrap tests inside test.describe block; convert to test() blocks E2E-7 → add a positive test() for each AC with no coverage E2E-8 → add a negative test() for each AC missing one E2E-9 → replace hardcoded base URLs with baseURL reference E2E-10 → replace page.waitForTimeout() with expect(locator).toBeVisible() or waitForSelector() E2E-11 → add at least one expect() assertion to each test that has none E2E-12 → for each unverified URL path: read host project router files; update spec with verified path; add TODO comment if cannot determine Save both .page.js and .spec.js.

For each selected issue: TD-1 → re-run /aiqa-generatetestdata {suite_name} to create missing files TD-2 → replace generic placeholders with domain-specific realistic values TD-3 → load credentials from config.yaml test_users; update valid.json with actual username(s); NEVER show passwords in plain text TD-4 → add missing edge cases: empty strings, null, 256+ char string, special chars, zero, negatives TD-5 → add SQL injection (' OR '1'='1--), XSS (<script>alert(1)</script>), oversized input (10,000 chars) to security.json TD-6 → fix JSON syntax errors; validate parse after fix TD-7 → cross-reference field names with spec; rename mismatched keys; add missing keys TD-8 → ask user for the correct expected success/error messages; update accordingly Save all corrected files.

For each selected issue: P5-1 → re-run the full suite to regenerate junit.xml: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs run-tests --suite "{suite_name}" P5-2 → for each failure in junit.xml with no bug report: create BUG-XXXX.md now from the failure node P5-3 → for each report with vague root cause: re-read stack trace; rewrite with file path, line number, specific error P5-4 → for each report missing before/after code: add the fix that was applied P5-5 → for each report missing retest outcome: re-run the test; append result to the report P5-6 → update test-checklist.md: mark every test as ✅ or ❌ based on junit.xml; remove any ⏳ Pending P5-8 → if bug count ≠ failed test count: create missing reports or remove incorrectly created ones Save all modified files.

For each selected issue: BG-1 → for each failure in junit.xml with no bug report: create BUG-XXXX.md now; read the junit.xml failure node for details BG-2 → for each report missing required fields: populate every blank field from the junit.xml failure node BG-3 → check Playwright test-results/ for screenshots/videos/traces; add paths to reports; add console errors from junit.xml <system-err> BG-4 → re-evaluate severity for each inflated/wrong classification using the heuristic: حرجة/عالية/متوسطة/منخفضة BG-5 → rewrite vague RCA with: specific file path, line number, what exactly failed and why BG-6 → add a concrete suggested fix to each report lacking one BG-7 → translate non-{reporting_language} content to {reporting_language} BG-8 → renumber duplicate/out-of-sequence IDs sequentially; update INDEX.md Save all modified bug reports.

For each selected issue: QR-1 → re-run /aiqa-generatereport {suite_name} to regenerate any missing report file QR-2 → recalculate pass rate from junit.xml; update the figure in all 3 report formats QR-3 → recount bug-reports/ files; update the bug count in all 3 report formats QR-4 → add any missing test results to the results table in HTML and MD; add rows to XLSX QR-5 → translate non-{reporting_language} content to {reporting_language} QR-6 → parse HTML; fix unclosed tags, mismatched elements, broken table structure QR-7 → add missing MD sections: executive summary, pass rate, failed test list, severity breakdown, next actions QR-8 → add quality gate result prominently: "✅ PASSED — {actual_pass_rate}% ≥ {min_pass_rate}%" or "❌ FAILED — ..." Save all corrected report files.
